description: RFC 3977 §7.6.3 allows 'LIST ACTIVE [wildmat]'. parse_command parses 'LIST ACTIVE' without extracting the wildmat argument (splits on first whitespace only). handle_list_active_live() takes no wildmat parameter and returns all groups. So 'LIST ACTIVE comp.*' returns all groups including alt.* groups. A newsreader that sends 'LIST ACTIVE comp.*' to avoid downloading thousands of unneeded group descriptions will receive the full list and potentially time out or display wrong groups. The list_active() function in commands/list.rs already supports wildmat; handle_list_active_live needs to plumb it through.
title: LIST ACTIVE wildmat arg silently ignored in live handler
